title: Orion S.A. 8-K Filing — Departure of Director
summary: Orion S.A. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026 announcing that Director Michel Wurth will not stand for re-election at the 2026 Annual General Meeting due to increased responsibilities with other endeavors. The company stated the departure is not related to any disagreement with the company or board.
key_points: Director Michel Wurth announced on April 6, 2026 his decision not to stand for re-election
Departure attributed to increased responsibilities with other endeavors
The filing explicitly states the departure was not the result of any disagreement with the Company or the Board
Signed by CFO Jon Puckett on April 10, 2026
